masthead.label: CAPITAL & PARTNERS
masthead.lede: For financial institutions and long-term partners who want to understand how the group is built and run.

rows.body: Permanent ownership. A recurring-revenue orientation across design, software, and services. Operating discipline over financial engineering.

A New Zealand company established in 2016, and a Japanese company incorporated in Yokohama in 2026 — separate entities under common leadership, each clear in its own jurisdiction, operating brands beneath.
A decade of continuous operation, including an anchor enterprise relationship of more than ten years.

note.label: A NOTE
note.body: We are not raising capital. We welcome conversations with financial institutions and aligned long-term partners — as introductions, not as pitches.
